Reported scores select checkpoints on source VAL; they are not untouched evaluation estimates.
Three seeds describe optimization/anchor variation, not independent subjects.
Maximum budgets match; early stopping produces unequal realized compute.
Model capacities differ; this is the frozen repository-baseline policy, not evidence of published AttnSleep accuracy.

AttnSleep is weak, including no N3/REM predictions at the selected seed-789 checkpoint.

No external cohort, clinical morphology, novelty or SOTA claim is established.
